name: GeoNames gazetteer

measures.definition: Where a place is (coordinates), what it is called, how many people live there, its time zone and the region it belongs to.

rights.edition: GeoNames records via Open-Meteo's geocoder and the GeoNames dump, read 2026-10-27
rights.attribution: Places, coordinates, populations and time zones from GeoNames (geonames.org), CC BY 4.0

fetch.rateLimit: Open-Meteo free tier: 10,000 calls a day, non-commercial

alternatives.key: a free GeoNames username (geonames.org/login), set as GEONAMES_USERNAME

alternatives.note: every place over 15,000 people, for offline resolving in the CLI

vetted.notes: The reference open gazetteer; Open-Meteo's geocoder serves the same GeoNames records with CORS and no key.

caveats: Population is GeoNames' figure, often the municipality, not the metro area.
